title: Qute namespace extensions without parameters don't work in Quarkus 1.12.0.FINAL
body:
**Describe the bug**
I started giving Quarkus 1.12.0.FINAL a try and potentially found a bug.

When I add a template extensions with a namespace and without any parameters it makes Quarkus 1.12 fail to start. This works fine in previous Quarkus releases and should be supported according to the documentation.

See https://quarkus.io/guides/qute-reference#template_extension_methods

**Expected behavior**
Namespace template extensions work without parameters
